units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 22:40">Targ. Y. Num. XXII, 40</cite>.—
<cite ref="Gittin 69a:2">Gitt. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>ולִיחֲרוּ לכלבא וכ׳</he> and let them stab the dog in the pupil of his eye.

senses.gloss: to blow the nose, sneeze, to give a sign by means of a nasal sound. Ib. 68ᵃ נ׳ ליה רב וכ׳ R. Ḥ. uttered a sound of warning behind him.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 152b:9">Sabb. 152ᵇ</cite> <he>נ׳ בהו וכ׳</he> R. A. (who was buried there) snorted at them (warned them off; Ag. Hatt. <he>נהם</he>).
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 34b:9">R. Hash. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>כי נְחִירְנָא לך</he> (ed. <he>נהירנא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8) when I give thee a sign.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 81b:1">Kidd. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>נַחֲרוּ ביה</he> they rebuked him (for his misbehavior).
